meta.note: Priority 1 = life safety at minute scale; counts are press/agency figures that changed over time and between sources.

impact_pathways.impact: Loss of life (drowning, burial, debris impact)
impact_pathways.magnitude_evidence: 26 Aug 2026: ~1,410 dead and ~6,145 unaccounted for in Nepal, 1,453 dead incl. Tibet side (Explorersweb, later tally); NDRRMA 3 Sep: 1,252 dead, 4,216 missing; counts differ by source and date. Melamchi 2021: 17-21 dead (sources differ). Sept 2024: >=217 dead, 28 missing by 1 Oct (secondary). Rasuwagadhi July 2025: ~9 dead, ~19 missing.
vulnerable_groups: riverside households (Tamang communities in Hakubesi etc.)
impact_pathways.pathway: Source event -> ~7-10 min to first settlement (Syabrubesi ~14 km in <10 min) -> no/late alert -> too short to move uphill; secondary floods downstream hours later (Gaidakot 15:30).

impact_pathways.impact: Hydropower and construction workers trapped in tunnels/powerhouses/camps
impact_pathways.magnitude_evidence: IPPAN: 934 linked to 11 projects unaccounted for (29 Aug); energy minister 23 Sep: >800 remain missing; UT-1 573 unaccounted, UT-3B 122, Rasuwagadhi 93; 13 plants/~431 MW (about a tenth of national capacity) disconnected; Army prioritised 19 tunnels; 2 survivors after 9 days at Trishuli 3A where 40-45 were present vs 5-6 normal.
impact_pathways.pathway: No operator alarm known; underground, phones fail; portals/adits fill with mud; access cut by bridge loss -> rescue in days not hours.

impact_pathways.magnitude_evidence: Not quantified in sources read; 13,396 rescued by 7 Sep (Explorersweb); IFRC: local health facilities impacted, NRCS clinic deployment.
impact_pathways.pathway: Bridges/roads lost -> isolated communities -> delayed care; most casualties are fatalities/missing rather than injured.

impact_pathways.magnitude_evidence: IFRC (citing Climate Risk and Resilience Lab, preliminary): ~18,000 households affected, >6,000 homes completely damaged; 93,000 people at risk, CHF 18 M IFRC appeal; permanent-shelter benchmark NPR 500,000 (CHF ~2,700) per house in mountains.
impact_pathways.pathway: Flood-path settlements flattened; displaced people stay with neighbours or in open spaces; protection risks (SGBV, trafficking).

impact_pathways.impact: Livelihoods, livestock, agriculture and income shocks
impact_pathways.magnitude_evidence: WFP RCT Nepal 2022: early cash raised food consumption score 6%; Rai 2020 Karnali: avoided loss NPR 117,027/household (reported).
impact_pathways.pathway: Asset/livestock loss and debt -> negative coping; cash and livestock moves in 1-3 days can cut this for slow river floods.

impact_pathways.impact: WASH and disease (water scheme damage, displacement crowding)
impact_pathways.magnitude_evidence: IFRC 2026 appeal lists safe drinking water, hygiene kits, epidemic preparedness, rehabilitation of drinking water schemes as priorities; no case counts in sources.
impact_pathways.pathway: Damaged schemes + crowding -> diarrhoeal disease risk.

impact_pathways.impact: Infrastructure (hydropower, bridges, roads, banks, telecom, gauges)
impact_pathways.magnitude_evidence: 12 operating plants (431.1 MW) and 15 under construction (470 MW) damaged (Nepalnews); 22 concrete + 5 Bailey bridges swept away; 9 bank branches washed away (26 bank staff untraceable); 4 gauging stations destroyed; Jure 2014 and Melamchi 2021 also hit headworks.
vulnerable_groups: operators and lenders (ADB, AIIB, IFC, Exim)
impact_pathways.pathway: Peak debris loads exceed design; headworks/powerhouse and bridges destroyed; sensors lost, so warning degrades as flood propagates.

impact_pathways.impact: Trade and border crossing (Rasuwagadhi/Kyirong, Pasang Lhamu Highway)
impact_pathways.magnitude_evidence: July 2025: Miteri bridge destroyed, dry port inoperable, border closed; Aug 2026: border buildings, Gyirong port road and Rasuwagadhi crossing destroyed.
impact_pathways.pathway: Single chokepoint on a flood path: people present at crossing when event hits; economic loss through months of closure.

impact_pathways.magnitude_evidence: 403 tourists untraceable (341 foreign, 62 Nepali; Nepalnews); main Langtang trekking valley bypassed by the debris (Explorersweb).
impact_pathways.pathway: Alerts in Nepali only; registration data not linked to alert.

impact_pathways.magnitude_evidence: Tribhuvan Trishuli Secondary School (roll 1,643-1,650): ~900 on campus evacuated, school buried; 777 students displaced (Education Ministry, 17 Oct report); 14,500 children's schooling disrupted in 3 districts (Kathmandu Post 18 Sep; figure from headline).
impact_pathways.pathway: Daytime school hours, flood between 8:40-10:30 local = peak school commute/assembly.

impact_pathways.magnitude_evidence: Mongabay: repeated generic SMS with no consequence reduced trust; DHM mandate covers warning, not evacuation order; DHM budget cut 56%.
impact_pathways.pathway: Alert fatigue -> informal networks beat official SMS (4 independent calls reached the head teacher before the SMS).
